fault_injections.scope: Actual ROS/Gazebo/Nav2 endpoints. In-process test harness changes only simulation budget or appends existing worker fault-injection flags; production source is unchanged.

preflight_resolution: Initial ComplexityNav attempt failed before Gazebo: generated/native_contract.py was missing. Existing common_response/preflight.py reconstructed dependencies and verified locked hashes; a separate new attempt passed. Initial ERROR retained. No navigation outcome was replaced.
limitations: One case per configuration; no success-rate or performance ranking.
No native A/B rerun of the old runner; this verifies functional execution, not identical trajectories/physics.
All runs headless; separate GUI startup path remains covered by in-memory integration tests only.
The standing-group action succeeded but true XY error exceeded 0.20m; kept as an actual-goal failure.

Before the fix, native runs logged ROS node exit -2/255 during teardown even though Gazebo was clean and no owned process remained. Four native rechecks at6b8ae5e have no child-exit errors. Docker normal cases were validated at61667d8; Docker worker-fault teardown rechecked at6b8ae5e.

shutdown_fix.problem: Group SIGINT reaches launch and its children; launch forwards SIGINT again and interrupts node teardown. Before-fix exit errors are retained per case.
shutdown_fix.change: SIGINT to ROS launch parent only, wait up to15s, retain owned group fallback and RuntimeGuard cleanup. Worker/GUI stopping unchanged.
